name: global-shopaholics
description: Buy from any US store and ship worldwide: shipping rates, landed cost, assisted purchase, tracking.
long_description: Connects Claude to the free public Global Shopaholics MCP server (https://mcp.globalshopaholics.com/mcp). Get live DHL, FedEx, UPS and USPS rates from the GS US warehouse to any country, estimate total landed cost including customs duties and import taxes, get a free US shipping address, and ask Global Shopaholics to buy an item from any US store for you. GS confirms every order and its total by email before buying; nothing is charged in chat. Legal items only.

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description: Live DHL/FedEx/UPS/USPS shipping prices and transit times from the US to any country.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Item + GS fee + shipping + estimated customs duties and import taxes.

tools.name: get_services_and_fees
tools.description: Global Shopaholics services, plans, fees and payment methods.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Get a free US shipping address for package forwarding.

tools.name: request_assisted_purchase
tools.description: Ask GS to buy from any US store for you (confirmed by email; nothing charged in chat).

tools.name: request_shipment_quote
tools.description: Custom quote for heavy/oversize, freight or customs paperwork.

tools.name: create_crypto_payment
tools.description: Crypto checkout link for an amount GS has quoted (0% fee).

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Carrier tracking link for DHL, FedEx, UPS or USPS.

prompts.name: buy-and-ship
prompts.description: Estimate the total cost of a US product delivered to your country, then get a US address or ask GS to buy it.
prompts.text: I want to buy ${arguments.product} from a US store and get it delivered to ${arguments.country} using Global Shopaholics. Estimate the total landed cost, show the best shipping options, then ask whether I'll buy it myself or want GS to buy it.
